svg.title: Scaling Laws at a glance
svg.desc: Parameters and data jointly determine training compute, while validation loss falls as a power law with diminishing returns.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Model size, training data and compute form one constrained system
More of one means less of the other
Fixed compute means choosing an allocation, not maximizing one variable.
